text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking down the hallway, I 
heard loud voices coming from a classroom—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Dober-san! Today's race was amazing, YES! 
CONGRATULAAAATIOOONS!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Especially that final straight! VERY SO 
COOL! Cutting through the wind like that, 
I was totally mesmerized!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: —Kh.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
—NON-NON! That's where you immediately 
SMILE! You've been going quiet at the 
exact same spot, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
B-But you're complimenting me out of 
nowhere...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm playing the fan, so OF COURSE I am! At 
this rate, it won't be proper training!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
When I get praised, I'm super happy and I 
SMILE! Do you hate getting complimented, 
Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I hate it, exactly... It's 
just knowing people are watching me that 
closely...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, I just... wonder if 
I'm even worth praising in the first 
place—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Mmm~~? Mmmmm~~~~??

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Forget what I just said. I need to 
practice more—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I GOT IT! In other words, Dober, 
you're just not used to receiving 
compliments!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wha-... How did you jump to that 
conclusion?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, VERY EASY! I'll just 
shower Dober with tons and tons of praise!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And Dober, you'll endure it with pure 
GUTS! Fight on! LET'S SPECIAL TRAINING!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Dober is super dependable! So kind! 
Usually all crisp and cool!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And your hair is silky-smooth and SO 
BEAUTIFUL! When eating parfaits, you're SO 
CUTE!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
~~~~kh! S-So sudden...! There's no way I 
can handle thissss!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah! The special training has only just 
begun!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Stop, stooop!
